Thanks again for the demo last week. We're pulling together the MAP and need a concrete throughput/TTFT plan + unit-econ estimates to present to procurement next Thurs. Primary asks:
- Sustained tokens/sec and sustained QPS we can expect for our 512-token average payloads

Elena

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a one-page MAP section (MAP_Ledgerly_ThroughputPlan_Aug2026.pdf) that summarizes our plan and the metrics we'll deliver. Short answers up front:
- Target sustained throughput: ~74k tokens/sec observed in 2x4-GPU pool for 512-token avg payloads (~145 QPS sustained).
- TTFT median: ~180–240 ms; p95: ~620 ms for the same config.
- Concurrency headroom: safe sustained concurrency up to 120 sessions; burst to 200 with autoscale (2–8s cold-start TTFT delta).
- Unit economics (raw infra + Redwood platform): ~ $55 / 1M tokens in the baseline profile (breakdown in attached).

We haven't completed the customer-dedicated 48h run on your exact workload mix yet. Rishi and Jasmine — can we commit to a 48-hour sustained run starting Monday (Aug 30) on the rw-13b-quant profile at the Ledgerly token distribution? Need: run-config-48h.yaml (attached), and I'll drop perf-results CSV when the run completes.

Next steps for the MAP:
1) We ship the MAP PDF to you (attached) for your deck.
2) Run: 48h sustained test (Mon–Wed next week).
3) Deliver: perf-results CSV + updated unit-econ sheet inside the MAP and a short summary slide.

I'll also include a HubSpot link to the mutual action plan and a DocuSign if procurement is ready for the contract term.

Sean

Quick update from the test cluster (preliminary, 24h snapshot):
- Config: rw-13b-quant, 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (2 pooled nodes).
- Sustained (24h avg): 69,800 tokens/sec (1m avg: 71,400).
- Sustained QPS @512 avg: 136 QPS (p95 182 QPS during short bursts).
- TTFT: median 195 ms; p95 610 ms; tail spikes to ~1.1s during short garbage-collect cycles when cache miss > 12%.
- Concurrency: stable up to 110 concurrent sessions; we saw graceful degradation past 170 concurrent sessions with increased TTFT variance.
- Cache: KV prefix caching produced a ~26% reduction in tokens/sec cost when hit-rate > 60%.

Attached: perf-results-20260831.csv (24h snapshot). Will continue to run full 48h and upload final CSV Tue morning. Jasmine, I'll tag you on the full run artifacts.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final MAP update — 48h run results and unit-econ (attached)

Elena —

Thanks for the patience. We've completed the 48h sustained run and updated the MAP section and unit-econ table. High-level results (final):
- 48h sustained tokens/sec (48h avg): 72,600 tokens/sec (1m peaks to 77,200).
- Sustained QPS @512 tokens: 141 QPS average; p95 188 QPS (short bursts).
- TTFT: median 190 ms; p95 605 ms; max observed 1.05s during a cache warm-up window.
- Concurrency: stable sustained operation at 120 concurrent sessions; safe burst to 210 with autoscaling.
- Cost: baseline infra cost (reserved pool) + Redwood platform fee => $53.8 / 1M tokens. With KV caching and suggested batching, projected unit-econ drops to ~$39.4 / 1M tokens (approx 26.8% reduction).

Attachments included: MAP_Ledgerly_ThroughputPlan_Aug2026.pdf (updated with results), perf-results-20260831.csv (24h snapshot), perf-results-20260902-48h.csv (final), and a one-slide unit-econ.csv.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-Ledgerly
